I’ll read the completed observations and frozen local call paths, then write the review only to `first-board-analysis.md`. I’ll keep the analysis offline and treat restoration as pending Root’s separate confirmation. I’m using the `xts-board-evidence` skill to preserve the evidence boundaries.

The three read phases each make 1,000 native LittleFS reads and seeks, with zero dirty-page hits. FILE requests 64 KB in total versus fd’s 20 KB, but the fd replay is slower in this run. I’m checking stdio and syscall handling before choosing a narrow next step.

The frozen call path still performs a descriptor seek and read for each operation. The measured mount-operation totals cover roughly 16–20 ms of each 43–47 ms read phase; the remainder also includes instrumentation publication, VFS work and scheduling, so it cannot be called pure ecall cost. I also found the separate default-IDF reference and am checking its actual libc buffer semantics.

The local default-IDF build has a relevant stdio optimization: Picolibc selects the file’s reported 4,096-byte block size for its FILE buffer and can seek within buffered data without calling `lseek`. Its native LittleFS cache is only 512 bytes. That makes call avoidance a concrete difference to investigate; increasing openvela’s buffer alone would still leave its seek-time invalidation in place.

The retained-window candidate now has a workload-specific basis: reconstructing the addresses reproduces the recorded digest, with no complete-record reuse in a retained 64-byte window. A retained 4,096-byte window could cover all reads after the first fill. I’m writing this as one isolated stdio candidate, including its extra memory cost and required position, failure and read/write semantics—not as a measured speedup.

Wrote [first-board-analysis.md](/home/regex/work/esp32s31-openvela/backups/xts-adaptation-and-test-evidence/korvo-fs-read-service/first-board-analysis.md).

It quantifies correctness, Flash/resource deltas and timing limits, and recommends one narrow stdio read-window candidate based on verified default-IDF buffering semantics. No speedup or restoration claim. Only the analysis file was created.
